title: Trump Signs Executive Order Renaming Lake Ontario 'Lake America' Amid Canada Trade War
detail: President Trump signed an executive order Thursday afternoon, August 27, 2026, renaming Lake Ontario as 'Lake America,' effective immediately within the federal government, escalating his trade war with Canada. Flanked in the Oval Office by maps of the Great Lakes labeled 'Lake America' over Lake Ontario, Trump directed the Board on Geographic Names to guide agencies to use the new name on maps, contracts, and communications, arguing the deepest parts and most of the lake's volume sit in US territory. It is the second time Trump has renamed an international body of water for the US, following the Gulf of Mexico's renaming to 'Gulf of America.' Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney rejected the move, noting the name Ontario derives from the Wendat word Ontari'io ('the lake is beautiful, the lake is big') and predates both Canadian Confederation and US independence by more than 400 years.

title: Trump Headlines Houston RNC Fundraiser Boosting Ken Paxton's Senate Bid
detail: President Trump traveled to Houston on Thursday, August 27, 2026, arriving at Ellington Field Joint Reserve Base before headlining a closed-press Republican National Committee fundraiser that evening to boost Texas Attorney General Ken Paxton's US Senate campaign, with tickets ranging from $10,000 to nearly $500,000. The Texas Senate race is viewed as a potential factor in control of the chamber after the November midterms. The visit was the first leg of a two-day Texas trip that continued with a White House-organized ceremony honoring the four Artemis II astronauts.
